item.subject: science
item.stem: During a science class in Pune, Meera tells her classmate Arjun that the temperature of a planet can be known just by checking how far it is from the Sun. Which statement correctly tests Meera's idea?

options.A: Meera is correct, because the planet closest to the Sun is always the hottest planet
options.B: Meera is not fully correct, because a thick atmosphere that traps heat can make a planet hotter than a planet closer to the Sun
options.C: Meera is not correct, because distance from the Sun has no effect at all on a planet's temperature
options.D: Meera is correct, because a planet's atmosphere cannot change its temperature
